gaps.lead: He spoke so quietly that the jury couldn't hear him.
gaps.sentence: He spoke ___ for the jury to hear him.
gaps.explanation: so quietly that nobody could hear = too quietly (for anybody) to hear.

gaps.lead: She hates it when people interrupt her.
Darius soon recovered after the operation on his knee and was able to rejoin the team.
gaps.sentence: After the operation on his knee, Darius ___ and was able to rejoin the team.
gaps.explanation: 'Recovered soon' is expressed with the noun: 'made a quick/fast/rapid recovery'.

gaps.lead: That's the school where my mother teaches.
gaps.explanation: where = in which in formal relative clauses.

gaps.lead: It took the artist three weeks to paint the mural.
gaps.explanation: it took X time to do = X spent time doing: spent over three weeks on.

gaps.lead: Perhaps she never received our message.
gaps.explanation: may/might have + participle = possibility in the past.
